raw_segments.text: Rent, it is to be observed, therefore, enters into the composition of the price of commodities
in a different way from wages and profit.
High or low wages and profit are the causes of high or low price.
High or low rent is the effect of it.
It is because high or low wages and profit must be paid, in order to bring a particular
commodity to market, that its price is high or low.
But it is because its price is high or low, a great deal more or very little more or no
more than what is sufficient to pay those wages and profit, that it affords a high rent
or a low rent or no rent at all.
